title: Closing and Funding: One Open Closing per Loan File
content:
**Rule.** A loan file may carry only one Closing and Funding engagement whose status is scheduled, documents out, signed or in rescission. Changing the closing method means cancelling the scheduled closing and scheduling a new one; changing only the date keeps the same closing. A funded, rescinded or cancelled closing does not block a new one, and a rescinded transaction needs a new application, not a new closing.

The check is made on the system record before a closing is scheduled: the closings recorded against the same loan file and their statuses.

| Status of an existing closing on the same loan file | Does it block scheduling another closing on that file? |
|---|---|
| scheduled | Yes |
| documents out | Yes |
| signed | Yes |
| in rescission | Yes |
| funded | No |
| rescinded | No (a new application is needed, not a new closing) |
| cancelled | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Only the date moves.** The closing record stays the same; no second closing is opened.
- **The closing method changes.** The scheduled closing is cancelled and a new closing is scheduled under the new method; the two are never open together.
- **Hypothetical:** a file whose only closing is funded can have a new closing scheduled; a file whose closing is signed cannot.
